mapper.sql: select id, name, params, owner_key, create_time, update_time from media_saved_filter
mapper.select: order by owner_key is not null, owner_key asc, name asc
mapper.insert: insert into media_saved_filter (name, params, owner_key, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{params}, #{ownerKey}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp)

insert into media_saved_filter (name, params, owner_key, create_time, update_time) select f.name, f.params, #{toOwnerKey}, f.create_time, f.update_time from media_saved_filter f where f.owner_key = #{fromOwnerKey} and not exists ( select 1 from media_saved_filter x where x.owner_key = #{toOwnerKey} and x.name = f.name )
